Drop the product logo files here (PNG / SVG / WebP), named as in manifest.json:
  exos.png, ironwolf.png, barracuda.png, firecuda.png, skyhawk.png, nytro.png
You can rename files or change labels by editing manifest.json.
Missing files are shown as styled text badges, so the app keeps working without them.
For "image" mode (one picture per ball) add more entries to "items" (you need at least as many as card cells).
